Edit events in OmaCal itself, without a trip to HEY's web page.

![OmaCal](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/crmne/omacal/v1.0.6/preview.png)

https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/88d5ff29-20e9-4e64-958d-b75dc3dade17

## New

- **Edit events in the panel.** Clicking an event now opens it in the event form, ready to change: title, day, times, time zones, place, calendar and reminder. `E` does the same for the event under way (or the next one), and `1` to `9` for that event of the day. Only what you change is sent to HEY, so everything else on the event stays as it was. **Join** and **Open in HEY** sit at the top of the form, for the meeting and for what the form does not cover (notes, guests, repeats).
- **This day or every day.** On a repeating event the form asks whether a change is for this day or for every day of the series. Changing one day needs hey-cli 1.6.0 or newer; with Omarchy's hey-cli 1.3.0 the form offers every day only.
- **Join from the day view.** An event with a meeting link shows a join button on hover, and while it is under way. `J` joins the meeting of the event under way, or the next one.

![An event open for editing in the panel](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/crmne/omacal/v1.0.6/screenshots/edit.png)

## Fixed

- **Multi-day all-day events show on their last day.** A trip from the 24th to the 26th showed on the 24th and 25th only. HEY stores the last day as the end date, and OmaCal read it as the day after.

## Known limitations

- **Some changes are still HEY's.** The form cannot remove every reminder from an event, change its notes, guests or repeats, or move a whole series to another day. Open in HEY is one click away for those.
- **Times are shown on this machine's clock.** HEY's listings do not say which zone an event was written in, so an event created in another zone opens in local time. Saving new times writes them in the zones the form shows.

## Install

```sh
omarchy plugin add https://github.com/crmne/omacal.git --enable
omarchy plugin disable omarchy.clock
```

Already installed: `omarchy plugin update crmne.omacal`.

OmaCal is an independent project, not created by, affiliated with, or supported by HEY or 37signals.

**Full changelog**: https://github.com/crmne/omacal/compare/v1.0.5...v1.0.6
